{"code": "import numpy as np

# Ensure baseline is properly marked as missing
df['biomarker_baseline'] = df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, np.nan)

# Compute change, where baseline is missing, change is NaN
df['biomarker_change'] = df['biomarker_final'] - df['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute mean change across all patients (including those with missing baseline)
mean_change = df['biomarker_change'].mean()

# Confirm number of valid baseline observations
n_valid_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'].notna().sum()

mean_change, n_valid_baseline"}
